name: mukscan-food-facts
description: Look up nutrition facts, ingredients and allergen labeling for about 320,000 Korean packaged foods from Korean government open data. Read-only, no sign-in.

interface.longDescription:
Mukscan Food Facts looks up the official label data of Korean packaged foods: nutrition facts, ingredients, allergen labeling and HACCP status for about 320,000 products registered with Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.

Ask about a snack, ramen, drink or sauce from a Korean store and get the numbers from government records instead of a guess. For example: how much sodium is in one bag of Saeukkang (새우깡), or how Shin Ramyun and Jin Ramen compare per 100g.

What it does
- Searches products by Korean name, optionally narrowed by manufacturer
- Shows nutrition facts (up to 15 nutrients) per 100g or 100ml and per package, the ingredient list when available, allergen labeling as recorded, and the data reference date
- Compares 2 to 5 products side by side per 100g

What it does not do
- No prices, stores, purchase links or ads
- No health judgments or diet advice
- No "safe to eat" verdicts on allergens. Allergen data exists for about 4.6% of products, and missing data does not mean a product is allergen-free. Always check the package label.

Data comes from Korean government open data (Ministry of Food and Drug Safety; Korea Agency of HACCP Accreditation and Services), published under KOGL Type 1. Every answer carries the source and the data reference date. Read-only, no account needed.
capabilities: Search Korean food products by name
Show nutrition facts, ingredients and allergen labeling
defaultPrompt: How much sodium is in one bag of 새우깡?
Compare 신라면 and 진라면 순한맛 per 100g
농심 새우깡 원재료랑 알레르기 표시 알려 줘

positive.description: Sodium per package for a named product
positive.prompt: How much sodium is in one bag of Nongshim 새우깡?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds 새우깡 by 농심 and reports sodium per package from the label data: 610mg per 90g bag (465kcal), with the data reference date and a note to check the package label.

positive.prompt: 신라면이랑 진라면 순한맛 100g당 나트륨 비교해 줘
positive.expected_behavior: Finds both products and compares them per 100g: 신라면 1,243mg vs 진라면(순한맛) 1,306mg sodium, both 348kcal. Makes no judgment about which is healthier.

positive.prompt: 농심 새우깡 원재료랑 알레르기 표시 알려 줘
positive.expected_behavior: Finds 새우깡 by 농심 and shows its ingredient list and the allergen labeling as recorded (밀, 새우, 대두, 우유 함유), and says the package label takes precedence.

positive.description: Sugars per package for a drink
positive.prompt: 빙그레 바나나맛우유 한 개 당류 얼마야?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds 바나나맛우유 by 빙그레 and reports sugars per package: 20g per 200mL (160kcal).

positive.description: Missing allergen data is not reported as allergen-free
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that there is no allergen data for this product, states that this does not mean it is peanut-free, and tells the user to check the package label. Does not say the product is safe.

negative.description: Health or weight-loss efficacy judgment. The plugin returns label data only and gives no diet or health advice; the expected response declines to judge and offers the nutrition facts instead.
negative.prompt: 이 과자 먹으면 살 빠져? (Will eating this snack help me lose weight?)

negative.description: Allergen safety verdict. The plugin never says a product is safe for an allergic person; it can only show recorded allergen labeling or that data is missing, and points to the package label and a medical professional.
negative.prompt: 땅콩 알레르기 있는데 진라면 먹어도 안전해? (I'm allergic to peanuts. Is Jin Ramen safe for me?)

negative.description: Prices, stores and purchase links are out of scope. The plugin has no price or shopping data and should say so rather than guess.
negative.prompt: 신라면 제일 싸게 파는 데 알려 줘 (Where can I buy Shin Ramyun cheapest?)

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, show prices or link to stores. It only returns food label data.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Three read-only tools over Korean packaged food label data: search_food_products, get_food_product and compare_food_products. No sign-in, no prices or purchase links.

ko-KR.subtitle: 한국 가공식품 영양성분 조회
ko-KR.description:
먹스캔은 한국 가공식품의 표시 정보를 찾아 주는 도구입니다. 식품의약품안전처에 품목제조보고된 제품 약 32만 개의 영양성분, 원재료, 알레르기 표시, HACCP 여부를 공공데이터 그대로 돌려줍니다.

마트에서 본 과자, 라면, 음료를 물어보면 AI 가 짐작하지 않고 정부 기록의 숫자로 답합니다. 예를 들어 새우깡 한 봉지의 나트륨, 신라면과 진라면 순한맛의 100g당 비교 같은 질문입니다.

할 수 있는 것
- 제품명(필요하면 제조사)으로 찾기
- 영양성분 최대 15종을 100g(음료는 100ml)당과 포장 한 개당으로, 원재료(있는 제품만), 알레르기 표시, 자료 기준일
- 제품 2~5개를 100g당으로 나란히 비교

하지 않는 것
- 가격, 판매처, 구매 링크, 광고
- 건강에 좋다·나쁘다 같은 판단이나 식단 조언
- 알레르기 "안전" 판정. 알레르기 자료는 약 4.6% 제품에만 있고, 자료가 없다는 것은 유발물질이 없다는 뜻이 아닙니다. 실제 포장 표시를 꼭 확인해 주세요.

출처는 식품의약품안전처·한국식품안전관리인증원 공공데이터(공공누리 제1유형)이며, 모든 답에 제공기관과 자료 기준일이 붙습니다. 읽기 전용이고 로그인이 필요 없습니다.
